scope: Descriptive comparison of five OpenRouter-routed models on three checkpoints from synthetic opportunity CB-2026-041.

methodological_lineage.name: Harvey Legal Agent Benchmark
methodological_lineage.methodology: Short professional request, closed matter, reviewable artifact, detailed binary criteria, strict all-pass headline, cost and latency reporting, and trajectory analysis.

routing.actual_backend_provider: Record when exposed by OpenRouter or OpenCode; otherwise report unavailable.
routing.identity_evidence: Harbor and ATIF prove the requested OpenCode model string. Unless provider response metadata is retained, they do not prove which backend endpoint OpenRouter selected.
routing.note: Exacto fixes the quality-oriented routing policy, not a backend endpoint. Provider selection may vary over time.

judge.same_family_risk: GPT-5.6 Luna is evaluated by a frozen judge from the same provider family.

acceptance: The lock resolves the intended immutable model string.
Agent execution completes without provider, OpenCode, Harbor, or Modal error.
The exact required artifact is present once in artifacts/manifest.json with status ok.
ATIF contains the user instruction and at least one agent step, and identifies the intended model and OpenCode version.
RewardKit completes with no nested verifier or judge error.
Agent duration and token telemetry are present; cost telemetry is numeric or explicitly unavailable.
canaries.repair_rule: Preserve every canary. Repair only same-origin infrastructure or task defects, version the replacement canary, and repeat all affected model-task canaries. Do not tune tasks or prompts to model weaknesses.

official_run.retry_rule: No Harbor retries and no selective replacement. Preserve an invalidated model job and, after repair, run a complete versioned 15-trial superseding job or report the model incomplete.

acceptance.infrastructure_failure: Provider, Modal, Harbor, artifact collection, judge, or verifier failure. Retain in planned and completion counts, but exclude from model performance.
acceptance.agent_invalid_output: Missing or malformed required DOCX after otherwise normal agent execution. Include as semantic score 0 and all_pass 0.
acceptance.accepted_trial: Normal agent execution, exact required artifact collected with status ok, complete ATIF, completed RewardKit grading, and no nested judge or verifier error.

reporting.headline: Strict all-pass by model and task.
reporting.primary_diagnostic: Equal-task macro semantic criterion pass rate.
adjacent: Per-task means and all five raw values
Pooled criterion pass rate as a diagnostic only
Document craft good, mixed, or poor, never blended into reward
Agent tokens and reported cost, judge cost, Modal cost, and phase latency
Machine trajectory audit and evidence-backed behavioral observations
Command-pattern behavior fields are observed indicators, not proof of intent or reasoning
reporting.manual_trace_sample: For each model-task pair, inspect the official trial with the earliest started_at timestamp, breaking ties by trial ID. Add every invalid, infrastructure failure, and semantic or craft outlier.

visual_review.procedure: Render and inspect every collected official DOCX under the frozen opaque-ID procedure before revealing model identity.

historical_baseline.placement: Adjacent historical direct-provider baseline only; never pooled into the comparison aggregate or ranking.

limitations: The five attempts measure observed rollout variation, not independent-matter accuracy.
The three tasks are linked checkpoints from one synthetic matter.
Sampling is unseeded and inference or reasoning compute is not equalized.
OpenRouter routing is fixed to Exacto but the backend provider is not pinned.
GPT-5.4 is an LLM judge, with same-family judge-bias risk for GPT-5.6 Luna.
Results do not establish statistical significance, general model superiority, or broad compute-market competence.
